field.name: menuitem
field.label: PLG_SYSTEM_MODULESNOWHERE_FIELD_MENUITEM_LABEL
field.query: SELECT id, title FROM #__menu WHERE client_id = 0 AND published = 1 AND ((link LIKE '%option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog%' ) OR (link LIKE '%option=com_content&view=categories%')) ORDER BY menutype, lft

field.name: modules
field.label: PLG_SYSTEM_MODULESNOWHERE_FIELD_MODULES_LABEL
field.query: SELECT id, CONCAT(title, ' (', id, ')') AS module_title FROM #__modules WHERE client_id = 0 AND published = 1 ORDER BY title

field.name: positions
field.label: PLG_SYSTEM_MODULESNOWHERE_FIELD_POSITIONS_LABEL
field.query: SELECT DISTINCT position AS value, position AS text FROM #__modules WHERE client_id = 0 AND position != '' ORDER BY position
